data.narrative:
Unseenlabs is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €112.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of six private peers at same or adjacent stages (Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, and Aalyria) and five public Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the €112.5M base, yielding $191M. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector comparables produces a $1.8B midpoint valuation, with a range spanning $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via EV/Revenue multiple (sector median 25.3x across five public names) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, typical for private companies. A third method—revenue multiple—remains inaccessible without top-line data.

The triangulated range spans $163M (low) to $2.1B (high), with a median of $991M. This wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in the peer set stage and maturity. Stage-progression implies the lower bound; peer-median suggests the center to upper range. Key uncertainties include the magnitude of revenue traction post-raise and how Unseenlabs' business model—satellite-based Earth observation for maritime and infrastructure intelligence—commands pricing relative to broader aerospace comps. Investor stage expectations and follow-on capital capacity remain critical valuation drivers.
